title: Pod in CrashLoopBackOff
steps: k8s_get pods in the affected namespace to confirm the state and the restart count
k8s_describe the pod to review the latest Events (OOMKilled, liveness probe failing, image pull error, etc.)
k8s_logs --previous for the crashing container, to see the error right before the last restart
If the pattern suggests a recent deploy, check the rollout history (with cloud_read or a read-only shell command)
Propose a concrete action (rollback, adjust resource limits, fix config) and its impact/risk before applying it
After applying the change, k8s_get again to confirm the pod has stabilized
